fact: On 10 June 2026 the head of the Personal Data Protection Authority met the State Digital Agency and International Mauritanian Telecommunications to discuss localising the Agency's data and accrediting the Nouakchott data centre, and presented the mechanisms required to localise data in data centres and the criteria for accrediting them.
